routes.name: Visa exemption
routes.summary: Schengen-area citizens get 90 days in any 180 without a visa. Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand citizens get up to 30 days for tourism. UK and Ireland are not included. No paid work.

other: Passport valid 6 months past entry for ASEAN citizens
Official list may change, check the page

stay.note: Schengen citizens 90 in 180. ASEAN four: up to 30 days, tourism only.

routes.name: Tourist Visa
routes.summary: Single-entry tourist visa, 30 days, available on arrival at staffed border posts or from an embassy. Can be extended once for 30 days.

other: Funds of US$100 per entry plus US$50 per day, unless a sponsor covers food and lodging
Good character and health
Passport valid 6 months from entry
People previously refused entry or with fines must apply before arriving

documents: Proof of funds, accommodation and onward travel if asked

routes.name: Business Visa (Class 1 and 2)
routes.summary: Class 1 is for exploring business, up to 60 days per entry. Class 2 is for people who run a company in Timor-Leste, 6 months extendable to 2 years.

other: Class 2: member or administrator of a company registered or being registered in Timor-Leste
Class 2: stay at least 183 days per year
Funds of US$100 per entry plus US$50 per day
Class 2 needs medical certificate and criminal record

stay.note: Class 1: 60 days per entry. Class 2: 6 months, extendable to 2 years.

routes.name: Transit Visa
routes.summary: Transit visa exists. Details were not read, check the official page.

other: Details not confirmed. See the official transit visa page.

routes.name: Working Visa
routes.summary: For paid work under a contract or service agreement, or volunteering over 120 days a year. Valid up to one year, multiple entry, renewable.

other: Employment must meet SEFOPE-certified standards
Medical certificate and criminal record
Proof of qualifications

routes.processing: Up to 30 working days (15 for SEFOPE, 15 for Migration Service).

routes.name: Visa to Establish Residence
routes.summary: 90-day multiple-entry visa you need before applying for a temporary resident permit. Used for professional activity and family reunification.

other: Proof of means of living, accommodation and return ticket
Medical certificate and criminal record
Family ties certified by the issuing consulate for reunification

routes.processing: Decision due within 30 working days. No decision in time counts as approved.

sources.label: Migration Service: visa to establish residence

routes.name: Temporary Resident Permit (Type A and B)
routes.summary: Type A covers professional activity, marriage to a citizen, family reunification and humanitarian cases. 2 years, renewable, work and study allowed. Type B is for missionaries, up to 5 years.

other: Be in Timor-Leste with a Visa to Establish Residence, unless exempt
No conviction over one year in prison
Good health, housing and means of support
Village chief declaration

routes.name: Permanent Resident Permit
routes.summary: No expiry, no limits on work, business or study. Routes: 10 years of lawful residence, 6 years on a temporary permit, or more than 5 years married to a Timorese citizen.

other: No conviction over one year in prison
Housing and means of support
Positive contribution to the economy or society
Apply inside the country

routes.name: Asylum
routes.summary: Asylum is handled by the Migration Service under the Law on Migration and Asylum. Details were not read, check the official page.

other: Process not confirmed from the official page
